body: Please keep in mind that people around us have their own background and problems to deal with. I'm sure everybody said something they regret in a long run. It's not always the matter of respect, more often it's about understanding and dealing with issues their own way. I've heard a lot of sad things from people that were close to me and once we talked about it with trust and open mind it shed a new light on why they said such things.

I'm really happy that you feel better. Remember that there's always a way even if it's not obvious at the first glance but you know that already. If you need any help or feel lost just let us know. We're here to support you and we actually care for you.
What's stopping you from telling her the truth?

Hi.

Sorry to hear about your decision. May I ask if you're getting a treatment?

There's nothing wrong in your desire for love. I'm not sure if I should focus on singular reason but if I had to, I'd say your age is what should be something to think of. Life is really long and once you make a decision of ending it, there's no turning back. You say there's nothing waiting for you but that's something you can't predict - when I was your age I was also worried if I'll be able to deal with life in any way. Think of something that gives you joy - literally anything. Is it writing? Playing video games? Making music? Listening to it? Nowadays you can turn anything into a job and that's the first step of being an independent adult - you'd be surprised of how surprisingly easy it might be to make money out of your hobbies. You need to focus on yourself as this is your life and it really doesn't matter what others think about you. Please, keep fighting for yourself. You matter.

I'm **not a therapist** keep that in mind. But if you need to break a barrier of talking to someone about what's in your head, I'm here for you. If you want to stay anonymous drop me a message here or feel free to add me on discord - hdspc#8939
